title: ChainSight AI
tagline: AI-powered DeFi risk, yield & bridge analytics using Uniswap and LI.FI
description:
ChainSight AI is an AI-powered DeFi analytics platform that helps traders and liquidity providers make better decisions using real on-chain data. Today, users often need to check multiple tools to understand pool risk, bridge fees, and execution time. This makes trading slow, confusing, and error-prone.

ChainSight AI brings this information into one simple dashboard. It pulls live data from Uniswap V3 smart contracts to analyze liquidity, fee tiers, ticks, and pricing state. It also integrates LI.FI to fetch real-time cross-chain routing quotes, including gas costs, bridge fees, and estimated execution time.

On top of this data, the platform uses AI to generate easy to understand summaries that explain risk levels, trading conditions, and recommended actions. Instead of reading raw blockchain numbers, users receive clear guidance that helps them avoid risky pools, reduce fees, and improve execution. The goal is to make DeFi safer, faster, and more accessible for both beginners and advanced users.
how_its_made:
ChainSight AI is built using a modern full stack architecture focused on real time blockchain data and performance. The frontend is developed with Next.js and TypeScript, using Tailwind CSS for responsive and clean UI design. This allows users to interact with pool analytics and routing data in real time through a fast web interface.

For on chain data, the backend directly reads Uniswap V3 smart contracts using public RPC providers. It retrieves liquidity, tick data, and price state from slot0 and pool contracts. For cross chain routing, the platform integrates the LI.FI API to fetch live quotes, gas estimates, bridge information, and execution times.

The AI layer is powered through HuggingFace hosted large language models, which take structured pool and routing data as input and generate human readable risk and strategy summaries. Custom API routes in Next.js handle data aggregation, validation, and prompt formatting before sending requests to the model.

All services are deployed on Vercel, with environment variables securely managing API keys. The project is fully open source and designed to be modular, allowing easy extension to additional chains, protocols, and analytics features in the future.
